fusions.name: Stoop
fusions.desc: A diving thrust at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away that deals 4 damage and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Downdraft Whirl
fusions.desc: Spins the shaft overhead and beats a gust outward that deals 12 wind damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks each one back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Vault on the Updraft
fusions.desc: Vaults you 5 tiles forward in the direction you are facing, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Running Launch
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
